name: The Husband
source:
The Widow's Husband was known throughout the town as the kind and gentle doctor. Everyone mourned when he passed. But behind closed doors and in the comfort of their home, he could drop his facade, revealing something more sinister.

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/the-widows-shadow]Itch.io[/url]]
